metadata.title: AI Citability Assessment & Optimization (Lite)
metadata.description: AI citability assessment and optimization. Analyzes web page content to determine how likely AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) are to cite or quote passages from the page. Gives a qualitative assessment per category with specific rewrite suggestions. Lite edition for workshop use.
metadata.author: BIQDADDY

configuration.purpose: Analyze web page content to determine how likely AI systems are to cite or quote passages, reporting a qualitative assessment per category with specific rewrite suggestions.

workflow.core_insight: AI language models cite passages that meet specific structural criteria. AI systems preferentially extract and cite passages that are self-contained, fact-rich, and directly answer a question in the first 1-2 sentences.

assessment_guide.total_score: ไม่มีคะแนนรวม ประเมินเป็นรายหมวด

category_1_answer_block_quality.description: Measures whether content contains clear, quotable answer passages that AI systems can extract verbatim.
category_1_answer_block_quality.assessment: ดี | พอใช้ | ต้องแก้

assessment_criteria.ดี: Every major section opens with a 1-2 sentence direct answer. Uses 'X is...' or 'X refers to...' patterns. The opening of each section stands alone as a complete answer.
assessment_criteria.พอใช้: Some sections have answer-like openings but many bury the answer in the middle or end of a paragraph. Definition patterns appear only occasionally.
assessment_criteria.ต้องแก้: Answers are buried in long narrative paragraphs, or there is no identifiable answer block at all. AI would struggle to extract any quotable passage.

what_to_look_for: Definition patterns: 'X is [definition].' / 'X refers to [explanation].' / 'X means [meaning].'
Answer-first structure: The answer appears in the first sentence, followed by supporting detail.
Quantified answers: 'The average cost of X is $Y' rather than 'Many factors affect the cost of X.'
Comparison answers: 'X differs from Y in three ways: [list]' rather than 'X and Y are often confused.'
category_1_answer_block_quality.high_citability_example: Content delivery networks (CDNs) are distributed server systems that cache and serve web content from locations geographically close to end users. A CDN reduces latency by 50-70% on average by serving assets from edge servers rather than a single origin server. The three largest CDN providers as of 2025 are Cloudflare (serving approximately 20% of all websites), Amazon CloudFront, and Akamai Technologies.
category_1_answer_block_quality.low_citability_example: If you've ever wondered why some websites load faster than others, the answer might surprise you. There's this amazing technology that has been around for a while now. It's changed the way we think about web performance. Let me explain how it works and why you should care about it for your business.

category_2_passage_self_containment.description: Measures whether individual passages can be extracted and understood without needing the surrounding content.
category_2_passage_self_containment.assessment: ดี | พอใช้ | ต้องแก้

assessment_criteria.ดี: Most content blocks are fully self-contained. Each passage names its subject explicitly and does not lean on pronouns that point back at earlier content.
assessment_criteria.พอใช้: Roughly half the content blocks are self-contained. Mixed use of explicit subjects and pronouns.
assessment_criteria.ต้องแก้: Few or no content blocks are self-contained. Content reads as a continuous narrative where extracting any paragraph loses its meaning.

checklist: Does the passage explicitly name the subject (not 'it', 'this', 'they')?
Can someone understand the main point reading ONLY this passage?
Does the passage contain at least one specific fact, statistic, or named entity?
Is the passage long enough to stand alone but short enough to quote?
Does the passage avoid starting with conjunctions ('But', 'However', 'And') that imply prior context?

category_3_structural_readability.description: Measures the structural formatting that helps AI systems parse and segment content.
category_3_structural_readability.assessment: ดี | พอใช้ | ต้องแก้

assessment_criteria.ดี: Clean H1 > H2 > H3 hierarchy. Question-based headings for informational content. Short paragraphs (2-4 sentences). Tables for comparisons, ordered lists for processes, unordered lists for features and options.
assessment_criteria.พอใช้: Heading hierarchy present but inconsistent. Few question-based headings. Mix of short and long paragraphs. Limited use of tables and lists.
assessment_criteria.ต้องแก้: No heading structure, or a badly broken hierarchy. Wall-of-text paragraphs. No tables or lists.

best_practices: Heading hierarchy: H1 (page title) > H2 (major sections) > H3 (subsections). Never skip levels.
Question-based headings: 'What is [topic]?' and 'How does [topic] work?' are directly matchable to AI queries.
Paragraph length: 2-4 sentences per paragraph. AI systems parse short paragraphs more reliably.
Tables: Use for any comparison of 3+ items. AI systems extract table data with high accuracy.
Lists: Use ordered lists for sequential processes, unordered lists for non-sequential items.
Bold key terms: Bold the first use of important terms. This aids AI entity recognition.

step_1_fetch_and_parse.description: Use WebFetch to retrieve the target URL. Extract main content area (exclude nav, footer, sidebar, ads). Preserve heading structure. Calculate total word count.

step_2_segment_into_blocks.description: Split content at each heading (H2 or H3). For each block record: heading text, full text, word count, number of paragraphs/lists/tables, number of statistics, definition pattern presence, and whether the opening sentences form a standalone answer.

step_3_assess_each_block.description: For each block judge the three categories independently and record ดี, พอใช้, or ต้องแก้ for each. Do not combine the three judgements into a single number.

step_4_generate_rewrite_suggestions.description: For each block assessed ต้องแก้ in any category: identify the primary weakness, propose a rewritten opening sentence using a definition or answer-first pattern, suggest specific statistics to add, and recommend structural improvements.

sections: Assessment Summary table (3 categories, each ดี / พอใช้ / ต้องแก้)
Strongest Content Blocks (top 2+ with quotes and explanations)
Weakest Content Blocks with current opening, problem, suggested rewrite, additional improvements

scope.single_mode: audit only: a live URL or saved source of a published page is required
scope.pre_write_design_handoff: Extraction-point design for unwritten pages belongs to seo-content-creation-lite Phase W4 (grouper question, word-for-word core term, keyword stuffing ceiling, snippet cut test). Never assess a bare outline and never create a parallel design rule set here.
scope.eeat_boundary: aiso-content-lite owns the E-E-A-T reading; this skill owns citability. When both run in one report, show two labelled results, never an average, never one standing in for the other.
